description_en: Removes a role from a member
name: RemoveMemberRole

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace. To get this ID, call the [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) operation.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. To get this ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html operation
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the member. To get this ID, see [ListMembers](~~449135~~).
parameters.help_en: The ID of the member. To get this ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449135.html
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.description_en:
The role to remove. Both official roles and custom roles are supported:

- Official roles: Valid values include the following. See [Appendix: Roles and permissions](~~2840449~~) for more information about the permissions of each role.

  - PAI.AlgoDeveloper: Algorithm developer.

  - PAI.AlgoOperator: Algorithm operator.

  - PAI.LabelManager: Label manager.

  - PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper: MaxCompute developer.

  - PAI.WorkspaceAdmin: Administrator.

  - PAI.WorkspaceGuest: Guest.

  - PAI.WorkspaceOwner: Owner.

- Custom roles: Specify the role ID. The ID must start with `role-`, for example, `role-sw******2tij`.
parameters.description_zh:
要删除的角色，支持官方角色与自定义角色：

- 官方角色：取值如下所示，各角色权限请参见[附录：角色及权限列表](~~2840449~~) 。
  - PAI.AlgoDeveloper：算法开发。
  - PAI.AlgoOperator：算法运维。
  - PAI.LabelManager：标注管理员。
  - PAI.MaxComputeDeveloper：MaxCompute开发。
  - PAI.WorkspaceAdmin：管理员。
  - PAI.WorkspaceGuest：访客。
  - PAI.WorkspaceOwner：负责人。
- 自定义角色：填写角色 ID。格式为 role-开头，例如 role-sw******2tij。
